verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has nothing about a setting or policy that lets users opt out of having their conversations used for model training. The approvals-security-and-privacy items cover only action approvals, auto-review rules and credential handoff. Those are adjacent trust controls, not training-data controls. A training opt-out is a fair question for an AI assistant, so this is 'none' rather than 'na'.

support.subject: As a knowledge-worker, I can control whether my conversations are used to train models
